# Majeed syndrome (*LPIN2*) corpus search log

*Generated by `analysis/corpus/majeed_search_summary.py` from this folder's files. Majeed syndrome is a substitute disease (pre-registration §4.2; Mondo MONDO:0012316); this corpus is preparation only and not part of the six-disease study. Search run 2026-11-15.*

## Methods

Every search method available to the session was used (Dr. Lin, 2026-11-15: "all methods"). The six registered corpora used only the first and fifth rows of the table below (D-35).

- **PubMed query** (`configs/diseases.yaml`, `substitutes.majeed`), Mondo synonyms included, run without the case/patient filter the six used, because for so rare a disease recall matters more than screening load:

```
("Majeed syndrome"[tiab] OR "Majeed syndrome"[nm] OR LPIN2[tiab] OR LPIN2[Gene Name] OR "lipin-2"[tiab] OR "lipin 2"[tiab] OR ("congenital dyserythropoietic"[tiab] AND osteomyelitis[tiab]) OR ("chronic recurrent multifocal osteomyelitis"[tiab] AND dyserythropoie*[tiab]) OR MJDS[tiab] OR (CRMO[tiab] AND CDA[tiab]))
```

  Hits: 213.
- **Europe PMC search**, which also searches open full text (`seeds/epmc_majeed_lpin2.csv`).
- **OpenAlex search** for "Majeed syndrome" in title, abstract or full text, and OpenAlex forward citations. Paged without an API key (cursor paging answered 401).
- **LitVar2 by gene symbol only** (pre-registration §5.1): every PMID linked to any of the variants LitVar lists for *LPIN2*, with no filter on any database assertion.
- **Backward citations** of the reviews Ferguson 2021, Chavan 2021, Badiger 2024 and Wang 2025, and of the gene-discovery paper Ferguson 2005 (Europe PMC reference index; partial lists are possible).
- **Forward citations** (Europe PMC and OpenAlex) and **PubMed similar articles** (top 50 each) of five key papers: Majeed 1989, Majeed 2001, Ferguson 2005, Al-Mosawi 2007 and Ferguson 2021.
- **Not used:** ClinVar or OMIM citation lists (pre-registration §5.1). Semantic Scholar answered 429 and Google Scholar has no API; neither was used.

Records with no PMID (preprints, theses, non-indexed journals, conference abstracts) are kept beside each source in `seeds/*_nopmid.csv` for hand review and are not screened: 484 rows over 11 files, with overlap between sources. Of these, 27 distinct records name Majeed syndrome or LPIN2 in the title (`nopmid_candidates.csv`, from `analysis/corpus/majeed_nopmid_candidates.py`), awaiting hand review.

## Screening (title and abstract)

- **Route:** Claude Code helper agents (Sonnet), batches of up to 100 records, each with its own scratch directory, following `pipeline/extract/claude_code/prompts/screen_v3.md` (v2 plus an optional `fulltext_mentions` field) with the disease block from `configs/diseases.yaml`. Launch text: `screening/launch_v2.txt`. A first round under `launch_v1.txt` (batches 1-3) was discarded because the helpers truncated abstracts or gave one stock reason to most rows; its labels are kept in `screening/labels_rejected_launch_v1/` and were not imported.
- **Full-text mentions:** for records whose title and abstract name neither the disease nor the gene, `analysis/corpus/fulltext_mentions.py` added up to five sentences from the open full text that do. Counts: {"records": 1319, "term_in_title_abstract": 246, "no_pmcid": 373, "no_fulltext": 220, "fulltext_no_term": 208, "with_mentions": 258, "already_done": 14}.
- **Relevance:** no 1176, unclear 110, yes 33.
- **In the extraction corpus:** 131 (relevance yes or unclear; case report, case series/cohort or review); by study type: case report 22, case series/cohort 30, review/meta-analysis 79.
- **Human check:** not yet done (`study_type_spotcheck.csv`).

## Full text

- **Fetched:** 79 of 131 corpus papers (60.3%). Access status: paywalled 49, europepmc_xml 47, pmc_efetch_xml 18, hand_fetched_free 9, publisher_pdf 5, not_found 3.
- **Free elsewhere (Europe PMC listing, not fetched):** 7.
- **Full-text screening** (`screen_fulltext_v1.md`): exclude 57, include 22, not_accessible 52. Exclusion reasons: no_individual_data 3, not_disease 19, not_english 1, review_no_new_individuals 34.
- **Eligible with full text:** 22 papers, of which 17 primary reports and 4 with a per-patient literature table.
- **D-08 threshold, for reference (at least 15 eligible primary reports with open full text):** met (17).

## Copies found by hand (2026-11-14)

Dr. Lin searched for the 88 records on `reports/majeed_papers_to_find_2026-11-15.md` (free copies only). Outcome: pdf_not_retrieved 24, access_required 19, pdf_downloaded 15, browser_security_block 14, navigation_failed 6, historical_chapter_not_retrieved 2, table_fragment 2, related_version_available 1, free_html_found 1, browser_download_block 1, related_translation_record 1, pdf_lead_not_retrieved 1, free_reader_found_pdf_blocked 1. Provenance and checksums: `data/literature/majeed/hand_retrieval_2026-11-14/`; files imported by `analysis/corpus/import_hand_fetched.py` (PDFs git-ignored).

- **PubMed papers:** 9 copies, full-text screened under the same instructions (batch 06): 2 included (15994876, 33993107).
- **Records with no PMID:** 7 documents screened by one helper with the same rule (`screening_fulltext/labels_nopmid/`). They are not in the manifest and not in the counts above.

| Record | Decision | Reason | Individuals | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| N64 | exclude | not_disease | 0 | Conference abstract; psoriasis patients and yeast expression of Lipin2 variants, no Majeed syndrome patient. |
| N66 | include | — | 2 | Conference abstract (poster, PReS 2011); two brothers with homozygous c.1312_1313delCT; document does not name another publication as reporting the same patients. |
| N76 | include | — | unclear | Preprint of a case report (one new patient) plus Table 1 of fourteen earlier patients; the document says it is a version of the BMC Med Genet paper doi 10.1186/s12881-019-0919-3; table rows are garbled so total count unclear. |
| N82 | exclude | no_individual_data | 0 | Definition entry (NCI Thesaurus via Qeios), one page, no patients. |
| N84 | exclude | no_individual_data | 0 | Definition entry (Orphanet via Qeios), one page, no patients. |
| N88 | include | — | 1 | Article (letter to the editor) with one new patient plus cell experiments. |
| additional_reference | exclude | review_no_new_individuals | 0 | Book chapter (GeneReviews); aggregate summaries only, no per-patient table. |

Likely duplicates for deduplication: N76 states it is a version of the BMC Medical Genetics case report (Liu 2019, PMID 31727123, already eligible); N66 (PReS 2011 abstract, two Turkish brothers homozygous for c.1312_1313delCT) very likely describes the brothers of Herlin 2013 (PMID 23087183, same variant).
